Implemented on work/ready-five, source commit a29a48abda2f00fdd9fb5de61f03983b91486d56 (source tree 94b9421735ea040a7a11aa95c1bed7e1ee8ec84f), based on 0d119db2.

Primary drag motion now draws provisional spans through the same plot transform without committing selection or host state. Release selects once; Escape/restore cancel an unfinished gesture. Playhead-only refresh preserves live shading instead of canceling the gesture.

Final JDK25 GITHUB_ACTIONS=true headless TimelineFxSuite: 8 passed, including changed actual pixels before release, reversed drag, exact selected rows, unchanged document, cancellation and playhead updates during dragging. S45ePlotFxSuite: 1 passed. Synthetic event-coordinate assertions use a named 0.001-ms JavaFX float roundoff bound; numerical laws and final row membership are unchanged.

All combined focused checks passed (JVM/JS regressions, Arrow IPC, rootJVM/Test/compile and rootJS/Test/compile with -Werror, Studio JS link, root hygiene/workflow checks, studioStyleCheck, checkBoundaries). The final FX run waited for the native archive run to release the machine-wide lock; no lock bypass was used. Local sbt-only metadata shim worked around existing sbt-git/JGit linked-worktree discovery and is excluded from commits.

Ready for review and later merge. Full landing gate/API audit/consumer qualification remains for the reviewed merged tree; no landing or closure claimed.
